mmq.text: Orim wakes with no memory and a dead guard's blood on her hands, taken in by the Cho-Arrim after the Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia.

She condemns Gerrard, who offers no defense, but she teaches the Cho-Arrim healers a less invasive method of healing and grows sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim as Cho-Manno takes the Weatherlight's arrival as a sign of Ramos's return.

She, Sisay and Hanna are sent to Saprazzo to fetch the Power Matrix, and a warrior beast drags Orim under the sea, until she returns riding a whale-like creature and heals the dying Sisay, then she is framed for murder and theft and cleared when Cho-Manno appears.
During the revolution she kills the Chief Magistrate with a Kyren poison dart, and she, Cho-Manno and Atalla become the new leaders of Mercadia as the crew planeshifts back to Dominaria.
